summary.hr: Kućna zbirka glazbe, filmova, serija, web-videozapisa i fotografija u tri modula: Library, Downloads i Player.
summary.en: A household collection of music, films, series, web video and photographs in three modules: Library, Downloads and Player.

summary.hr: Glazba, filmovi, serije, web-videozapisi i fotografije dijele glagole, a ne imenice. Vrsta se pojavi kad postoji njezina mapa.
summary.en: Music, films, series, web video and photographs share their verbs and none of their nouns. A kind appears once its folder is there.

summary.hr: Administrator, korisnik i gost. Profil kaže tko gleda, a televizor se pušta unutra kodom.
summary.en: Administrator, user and guest. A profile says who is watching, and a television is let in with a code.

summary.hr: Album se ima kad je cijeli i u traženoj kvaliteti, a film kad njegovi titlovi prođu provjeru.
summary.en: An album is had when it is whole and at the quality asked for, and a film when its subtitles pass the check.

summary.hr: Čitaju se ondje gdje jesu, lica postaju osobe kroz godine, a svatko ima privatni šifrirani trezor.
summary.en: Read where they are, faces become people across the years, and everyone has a private encrypted vault.

summary.hr: Ono što se prati stiže samo. Sve ostalo traži se u katalogu svoje vrste i dodaje u biblioteku.
summary.en: What is followed arrives on its own. Everything else is looked up in its kind's catalogue and added to the library.

title.en: The queue and what is missing

summary.hr: Jedan red za sve što je na putu, svaki redak u stanjima svoje vrste, i nepotpuni albumi imenom.
summary.en: One queue for everything on its way, each row in its own kind's states, and the incomplete albums by name.

summary.hr: Mape, predlošci imena, kvaliteta, titlovi i pragovi za lica uređuju se ovdje, a ne u datoteci.
summary.en: Folders, naming templates, quality, subtitles and the face thresholds are edited here, not in a file.

summary.hr: Jedno sučelje nad Usenetom, torrentom, Soulseekom i yt-dlp-om: traži, uzmi, prati i otkaži.
summary.en: One interface over Usenet, torrent, Soulseek and yt-dlp: search, grab, follow and cancel.

summary.hr: Police i otkrivanje, nastavak ondje gdje ste stali, preskakanje uvoda i slanje na televizor ili DAC.
summary.en: Shelves and discovery, picking up where you stopped, skipping the intro, and sending to the television or the DAC.

summary.hr: Na današnji dan, godine, osobe, mjesta i kviz, slanje s telefona u album i s albuma na televizor.
summary.en: On this day, years, people, places and the quiz, sending from the phone to the album and from the album to the television.

summary.hr: Vaš profil, titlovi, povijest i trezor, a za administratora diskovi, profili, televizori i zvučni izlazi.
summary.en: Your profile, subtitles, history and vault, and for the administrator the disks, profiles, televisions and sound outputs.
